changed_claims.change: Qualify SDK atomicity wording by synchronous contract receipt; detached withdrawal/auth-call work has separate settlement/recovery.
Allow implicit-account key identity; explicit prior registration is not universal.
Add contract pause gate separately from optional hosted service policy.
Detailed 1Click API describes refund initiation; quickstart calls it quote expiration. Keep stage-specific meaning.
No duplicate-generation/submission contract established; correlationId, nonce replay rejection and exactly-once settlement are distinct.
Duplicate request fan-out invalidates one-content-hash/one-obligation assumption.

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN a candidate execution is submitted, Moriarty SHALL verify owner authority separately from the bound program, intent-refinement, transition and history proof obligations.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN a candidate execution is submitted, Moriarty SHALL verify owner authority separately from the bound program, intent-refinement, transition and history proof obligations.
pl_research_questions: Which proof/interface composition prevents an authenticated proposer from substituting a weaker relation?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: A correctly signed candidate with a wrong fee recipient or unproved transition rejects.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN a stage completes, fails or becomes unknown, Moriarty SHALL preserve every undischarged liability and pending duty in its authenticated successor state.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN a stage completes, fails or becomes unknown, Moriarty SHALL preserve every undischarged liability and pending duty in its authenticated successor state.
pl_research_questions: How should affine capabilities and persistent obligations interact under weakening, exceptions and joins? Are graded/effect or dependent resource types sufficient?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: A successful sibling callback cannot drop debt or release the failed sibling reservation.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN a staged program is lowered to Midnight, Moriarty SHALL bind its guaranteed/fallible phase layout, per-phase authority consumption, fees, failure effects and remedies to the signed intention and proof statement.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN a staged program is lowered to Midnight, Moriarty SHALL bind its guaranteed/fallible phase layout, per-phase authority consumption, fees, failure effects and remedies to the signed intention and proof statement.
pl_research_questions: What simulation/refinement relation represents partial commits and charged failure without equating them to atomic source rollback?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: A fallible-phase failure retaining an unauthorized guaranteed debit or fee rejects.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN a contingent release is proposed, Moriarty SHALL require the bound combination of signatures, documents, proofs, recipient actions and other condition evidence under the declared domain/finality assumptions before releasing assets.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN a contingent release is proposed, Moriarty SHALL require the bound combination of signatures, documents, proofs, recipient actions and other condition evidence under the declared domain/finality assumptions before releasing assets.
pl_research_questions: How are temporal conditions and external observations typed without promoting attestations into arbitrary-program proofs?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: An MPC signature or solver success flag without delivery evidence cannot discharge the delivery duty.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN a continuation is resumed or retried, Moriarty SHALL authenticate the stage, attempt, predecessor and effect identities and prevent duplicate authority consumption while retaining unresolved earlier attempts.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN a continuation is resumed or retried, Moriarty SHALL authenticate the stage, attempt, predecessor and effect identities and prevent duplicate authority consumption while retaining unresolved earlier attempts.
pl_research_questions: Which identity/equivalence relation permits safe retries and shared requests without assuming at-most-one invocation per content hash?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: Two identical requests with separate pending yields cannot be collapsed into one obligation; a late first callback cannot cause a second payout.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN parallel branches join, Moriarty SHALL validate the required branch set and combine their complete effects, cumulative bounds and residual duties according to the declared join policy.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN parallel branches join, Moriarty SHALL validate the required branch set and combine their complete effects, cumulative bounds and residual duties according to the declared join policy.
pl_research_questions: Can dependent session types or effect rows represent arbitrary branch sets, failure sums and obligation-conserving joins?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: A callback swaps branch positions or omits a pending branch; the join rejects or remains pending under explicit policy.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN an expiry threshold is reached, Moriarty SHALL apply its signed stage-specific rule without inferring nonexecution or discharging existing duties from elapsed time alone.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN an expiry threshold is reached, Moriarty SHALL apply its signed stage-specific rule without inferring nonexecution or discharging existing duties from elapsed time alone.
pl_research_questions: How should validity deadlines, offer lifetimes, recovery eligibility and revocation be distinguished in temporal semantics?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: A deposit mined after a local timeout cannot automatically justify both refund and delivery release.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHILE a program uses supported semantics, Moriarty SHALL allow any developer to compile, prove, publish and deploy it without maintainer, hosted-solver, reviewer or registry approval, subject to objective ledger validity, owner authorization and explicit signed application policy.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHILE a program uses supported semantics, Moriarty SHALL allow any developer to compile, prove, publish and deploy it without maintainer, hosted-solver, reviewer or registry approval, subject to objective ledger validity, owner authorization and explicit signed application policy.
pl_research_questions: How can optional service/application policy remain composable without becoming language-wide program admission?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: Two independently produced plans satisfying the same signed counterparty/application policy receive equivalent objective treatment; missing partner JWT does not prevent local compilation or owner-controlled submission.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN the owner signs an intention, Moriarty SHALL bind a versioned canonical machine-readable payload and present the same asset, recipient, fee, liability, partial-outcome and recovery constraints in the inspectable signing display.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN the owner signs an intention, Moriarty SHALL bind a versioned canonical machine-readable payload and present the same asset, recipient, fee, liability, partial-outcome and recovery constraints in the inspectable signing display.
pl_research_questions: What parser/version/canonicalization correspondence is necessary across native-wallet signing standards and semantic hashes?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: Payload reserialization or changed domain cannot preserve signature acceptance accidentally; a valid signature over a different displayed intent rejects.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

proposed_ears_requirements.ears: WHEN candidate plans are ranked, Moriarty SHALL first establish each candidate satisfies the immutable signed hard constraints and bound program proof relation.
proposed_ears_requirements.behavioral_requirement: WHEN candidate plans are ranked, Moriarty SHALL first establish each candidate satisfies the immutable signed hard constraints and bound program proof relation.
pl_research_questions: How can optimization/refinement interfaces expose preferences without weakening hard constraints?
proposed_ears_requirements.adversarial_acceptance_scenario: A higher-output quote with a different input asset or extra liability is rejected before ranking.
proposed_ears_requirements.status: proposed; theory solution and implementation unresolved

dissent_and_gaps: Contingent settlement means submit to a destination and wait for a composable combination of signatures, documents, proofs, recipient actions and other specified conditions; recorded funding is distinct from final delivery. No selected PL mechanism; compare dependent/session/refinement/effect/resource systems before choosing syntax or metatheory.
No general permissionless arbitrary-program correctness proof is established by inspected NEAR signatures or accounting.
1Click hosted endpoint schemas omit the operational idempotency and exact retry contract needed for a safe adapter.
Current confidential route requirements do not establish confidentiality, noninterference or independent delivery proofs.
Protocol pause/control roles cannot be erased from NEAR trust analysis, nor imported as universal Moriarty admission.
RPC publish_intents prose conflicts with conditional requote=false default; do not claim unconditional retries.
Cross-chain finality/oracle/bridge/liveness assumptions and ZKIRv3 ledger correspondence remain separate proof obligations.
